content:
200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully updated the user group.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The number of users in the group.
integer
The permissions for the group.
string
The name of the group.
string
The UUID for the group.
integer
The unique ID of the group.
— 400 Returned if your request message contains an invalid parameter.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to edit a group.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management cannot find the specified group.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management fails to edit the group.
